title: Bilateral Evidence Selection and Reasoning for Mammography Vision--Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.25418v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Medical vision--language models (VLMs) often need to identify small, subtle lesions within high-resolution images containing extensive normal anatomy and redundant visual information. Visual-token compression improves efficiency, but preserving salient regions alone can discard the context needed for diagnostic interpretation. This context can extend across images: in bilateral mammography, the opposite breast provides a patient-specific anatomical reference. Yet retaining such evidence does not ensure that the model uses it effectively. We propose Bilateral Evidence Selection and Reasoning (BESR), which connects evidence preservation with comparative assessment through a bilateral-guided token selector and a bilateral reward. Under a shared token budget, the selector jointly prioritizes lesion appearance and its local and bilateral context, while the reward encourages assessments that benefit from the preserved comparison. translated_title: 面向乳腺X线摄影视觉-语言模型的双侧证据选择与推理
translated_abstract: 医学视觉-语言模型通常需要在包含大量正常解剖结构和冗余视觉信息的高分辨率图像中识别细小、隐蔽的病灶。视觉token压缩可以提升效率，但仅保留显著区域可能会丢弃诊断解读所需的上下文。这种上下文可以跨越图像延伸：在双侧乳腺X线摄影中，对侧乳房提供了患者特异性的解剖学参照。然而，保留此类证据并不能保证模型能够有效地加以利用。我们提出了双侧证据选择与推理，通过双侧引导的token选择器和双侧奖励机制，将证据保留与对比评估联系起来。在共享的token预算下，选择器同时优先考虑病灶外观及其局部与双侧上下文，而奖励机制则鼓励模型利用所保留的对比信息进行评估。实验
tldr: 该论文提出BESR方法，通过双侧引导的token选择器与双侧奖励机制，在视觉token压缩过程中同时保留病灶及其对侧乳腺的对比上下文，使乳腺X线摄影视觉-语言模型能够有效利用双侧对比信息进行诊断评估。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes BESR, which couples a bilateral-guided token selector with a bilateral reward to preserve lesion and contralateral breast context during visual token compression, enabling mammography vision-language models to effectively leverage bilateral comparison for diagnostic assessment.
